developer_paper.summary: Historical rest pose is the player-created body configuration, not a predefined universal pose; reasonable rest is assumed. Motion can use rest-relative, size/limb-scaled, ground-relative or target-relative coordinate modes. All modes preserve rest as origin. UprightSpine evaluates a predominantly prone/upright heuristic to branch binding; threshold code absent. This concerns morphology and animation semantics, not personality inference.
limits: Historical developer design, not current local native trace.
Does not specify editor default neutral pose, capability Posture consumer or player soul-style system.
